text:
maria: Quick async standup — kernel / batching / KV bench notes.

what I did yesterday: landed the micro-batcher change that collapses tiny batches under 12 tokens into the main slot; ran a quick smoke bench against `redwood-mini` and saw tail p99 improvement. opened PR #4321 for the change.

blockers: still seeing odd KV hitrate regressions on long-tail prefixes (some customers show 8-12% lower hit during warmup). @cheng can you sanity-check the eviction heuristics I touched?

plan for today: pair with @sam for a perf sweep, run wider benchmarks, and draft a rollback plan if the hitrate drop persists. will also push a canary to two Dedicated shards.

cheng: looking now. initial glance — the micro-batcher looks fine, but I think the prefetch window math is off for >1024 sequences. quick patch I tried locally: ```diff
- prefetch.window = 128
+ prefetch.window = 256
```
that bumped local KV hit from 78% -> 86% on synthetic replay (seq dist skewed). pushing branch `kv-prefetch-fix` for validation.

sam: nice. I ran a 30m bench overnight with the micro-batcher + updated prefetch, here are roughs:
```
model=redwood-mini  bs=8  seq=512
requests=12k  tokens=6.1M
p50=12ms p95=42ms p99=98ms
kv_hitrate=85.9%

after prefetch change
p50=11ms p95=35ms p99=80ms
cost/token ~ -6%
```
no regression on CPU fallback path. I'll run a longer run against mixed seq distribution and post a full CSV.

liam: I can take the canary rollout; will do 10% -> 30% -> 100% if metrics look good. ping me when branch is ready. also will add an alert on kv_hitrate drop below 75% during rollouts.

maria: thanks. @deploy-bot can you schedule a canary for `eng-dedicated-us-east-2` at 11:30 PT?

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: canary `canary-176234` target=eng-dedicated-us-east-2 start=1762349800 (11:30 PT) — will report status updates in this thread.

cheng: I'll run the longer replay and attach logs to PR #4321. if we still see gaps, next step is adding a tiny KV probe during warmup to prime heavy prefixes.

sam: FYI I left a couple of comments on PR #4321 (mainly around tests and a small nit in docstring). nothing blocking.

maria: perfect. action items: 1) cheng run full replay + attach logs, 2) sam run long mixed-seq bench and drop CSV, 3) liam run canary and watch kv_hitrate + p95, 4) maria will keep rollback ready and prepare a short postmortem template if needed.

liam: noted. I'll post the canary dashboard link when the job starts. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks team — if anyone hits a hard blocker call in the `eng-oncall` channel. otherwise we'll sync in tomorrow's async.

deploy-bot: canary started: canary-176234 -> 10% traffic. monitoring kv_hitrate, p95, errors. next update at +5m or on change.
